verdict.rationale: Muse lets users name/shape the persona's tone ("Name it, shape how it talks, and make it your own") and stores persistent memory about the user in its VM, with a Forget skill to remove specific info, suggesting some persistent personalization. However there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated 'custom instructions' or system-prompt-style setting that consistently shapes every response beyond persona flavor and memory recall. Missing for 10: explicit custom-instructions/system-prompt feature, evidence that saved preferences are applied consistently across all response types, and independent confirmation of this behavior.
